sources.title: [2605.26029] CausaLab: A Scalable Environment for Interactive Causal ...
sources.snippet: We introduce CausaLab, a scalable environment for evaluating interactive causal discovery by LLM agents. Unlike prior evaluations, CausaLab evaluates both whether an agent can solve a problem using causal evidence and whether its answer is grounded in a faithful recovered causal mechanism. sources.title: Building a Tiny Agent Context Compactor in TypeScript
sources.snippet: AI agents re-read every tool result on every single turn, rapidly inflating API costs. Learn how to build a zero-dependency, rule-based context compactor in TypeScript to reduce agent token consumption by up to 96%.
